subject: Re: Local ads for every BrightBite Burgers location
body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for this, it's on our radar. We tried a template tool last year and it went badly: franchisees changed logos, colours and offers however they liked, and corporate spent weeks cleaning it up.

Before I put time on the calendar: how would your system stop that? Can corporate control what franchisees are allowed to change?

Maya

subject: Re: Local ads for every BrightBite Burgers location
body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks, that's what I needed to hear. Locked fields with approval is exactly what we're missing, and the timing is good. We're planning a national menu launch in Q1 and our franchisees keep asking for local versions of the ads. Right now each regional version takes our team weeks.

Could we set up a 30-minute call next week? Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon works for me. I'd like our CFO, Ken, to join for the second half.

Best,
Maya

subject: Re: Local ads for every BrightBite Burgers location
body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for sending the IO so quickly. Ken reviewed it and is happy with everything except one point: he'd like Net 45 payment terms instead of Net 30.

If you can send an updated version, he'll sign it this week.

Maya

subject: Re: Creative at scale across Copperline Creative's clients
body:
Hi Daniel,

Interesting, but our budget is locked until Q1. Also, we pay our current vendor a flat fee and I'm worried your pricing would be higher. Can you send me your rate card so I can compare?

Sam
